Interface SessionRepository

All Known Implementing Classes:
InMemorySessionRepository
public interface SessionRepository
Stores Sessions. The in-memory implementation lives in the infrastructure layer; a database-backed one could replace it without touching the domain.

    • persist

      void persist(Session session)
      Saves the session. The stored version must equal Session.version(), the version it was loaded at; each successful save advances the stored version by one, so reload before changing the session again.
      Throws:
      StaleAggregateException - if the stored version differs from the session's version
